志第二天文二
Treatise on Astronomy, Part Two.
2
▲月掩犯五纬
▲ The moon occulting and encroaching upon the five planets.
3
洪武元年五月甲申，犯填星。 十二年三月戊辰朔，犯辰星。 十四年十一月甲午，犯填星。 十九年五月己未，犯岁星。 二十三年四月丁酉，掩太白。 十一月癸卯及永乐四年正月戊午，五年六月丙午，七年十二月壬子，俱犯荧惑。 八年十二月壬子，九年四月庚子，十六年七月戊辰，俱犯岁星。 十八年十一月辛卯，掩太白。 二十年三月辛未，掩填星。 二十二年八月乙丑，犯荧惑。
Hongwu 1, fifth month, day jiashen: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Hongwu 12, third month, new moon on wuchen: the moon encroached upon Mercury. Hongwu 14, eleventh month, day jiawu: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Hongwu 19, fifth month, day jiwei: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Hongwu 23, fourth month, day dingyou: the moon occulted Venus. Hongwu 23, eleventh month, day guimao, and Yongle 4/I/wuwu, 5/VI/bingwu, and 7/XII/renzi: in each case the moon encroached upon Mars. Yongle 8/XII/renzi, 9/IV/gengzi, and 16/VII/wuchen: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on all three dates. Yongle 18, eleventh month, day xinmao: the moon occulted Venus. Yongle 20, third month, day xinwei: the moon occulted Saturn. Yongle 22, eighth month, day yichou: the moon encroached upon Mars.
4
洪熙元年二月己未，掩填星。
Hongxi 1, second month, day jiwei: the moon occulted Saturn.
5
宣德元年十二月丙子，掩荧惑。 二年正月癸卯，犯荧惑。 四月甲申，犯太白。 六年十月丙申，掩太白。 七年二月甲寅，犯填星。 八年二月癸巳，掩岁星。 四月戊子，犯岁星。
Xuande 1, twelfth month, day bingzi: the moon occulted Mars. Xuande 2, first month, day guimao: the moon encroached upon Mars. Xuande 2, fourth month, day jiashen: the moon encroached upon Venus. Xuande 6, tenth month, day bingshen: the moon occulted Venus. Xuande 7, second month, day jiayin: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Xuande 8, second month, day guisi: the moon occulted Jupiter. Xuande 8, fourth month, day wuzi: the moon encroached upon Jupiter.
6
正统二年正月辛亥，掩岁星。 四月癸酉、五月庚子，俱犯岁星。 七月戊申，犯荧惑。 四年正月乙酉，掩填星。 八年三月庚申，犯填星。 十一月丙寅，掩岁星。 十年十一月辛卯，犯荧惑。 十一年十二月甲寅，犯岁星。 十二年正月辛巳，闰四月庚午，俱犯岁星。 十四年四月壬子，犯太白。 五月癸未，掩太白。
Zhengtong 2, first month, day xinhai: the moon occulted Jupiter. Zhengtong 2, fourth month day guiyou and fifth month day gengzi: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on both dates. Zhengtong 2, seventh month, day wushen: the moon encroached upon Mars. Zhengtong 4, first month, day yiyou: the moon occulted Saturn. Zhengtong 8, third month, day gengshen: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Zhengtong 8, eleventh month, day bingyin: the moon occulted Jupiter. Zhengtong 10, eleventh month, day xinmao: the moon encroached upon Mars. Zhengtong 11, twelfth month, day jiayin: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Zhengtong 12, first month day xinsi and intercalary fourth month day gengwu: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on both dates. Zhengtong 14, fourth month, day renzi: the moon encroached upon Venus. Zhengtong 14, fifth month, day guiwei: the moon occulted Venus.
7
景泰二年四月戊子，犯岁星。 九月甲辰，犯岁星于斗。 五年二月丁亥，犯太白。 六年正月甲寅，犯岁星。 七年四月癸丑，犯填星。 乙丑，犯太白。
Jingtai 2, fourth month, day wuzi: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Jingtai 2, ninth month, day jiachen: the moon encroached upon Jupiter in the Dipper lodge. Jingtai 5, second month, day dinghai: the moon encroached upon Venus. Jingtai 6, first month, day jiayin: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Jingtai 7, fourth month, day guichou: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Jingtai 7, day yichou: the moon encroached upon Venus.
8
天顺五年十一月己亥，犯太白于斗。
Tianshun 5, eleventh month, day jihai: the moon encroached upon Venus in the Dipper lodge.
9
成化五年二月丙申、癸亥，俱犯岁星。 六年三月癸未，八年正月癸亥，俱犯太白。 十二年十一月戊申，犯岁星于室。 十三年十月乙卯，犯填星。 十二月丁酉，犯太白。 十四年三月戊辰，十八年二月戊午，俱犯填星。 八月己酉，二十三年四月乙亥，俱掩荧惑。 五月戊午，六月乙酉，俱犯岁星。 十月甲戌，掩岁星。
Chenghua 5, second month, days bingshen and guihai: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on both dates. Chenghua 6/III/guiwei and 8/I/guihai: the moon encroached upon Venus on both dates. Chenghua 12, eleventh month, day wushen: the moon encroached upon Jupiter in the Encampment lodge. Chenghua 13, tenth month, day yimao: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Chenghua 13, twelfth month, day dingyou: the moon encroached upon Venus. Chenghua 14/III/wuchen and 18/II/wuwu: the moon encroached upon Saturn on both dates. Chenghua 8/VIII/jiyou and 23/IV/yihai: the moon occulted Mars on both dates. Chenghua 23, fifth month day wuwu and sixth month day yiyou: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on both dates. Chenghua 23, tenth month, day jiaxu: the moon occulted Jupiter.
10
弘治四年二月壬子，犯岁星。 七年十一月戊申，犯荧惑。 八年正月癸卯，犯岁星。 十二月丙辰，掩填星。 十一年四月甲申、九月庚子，俱犯岁星。 十二年八月壬寅，犯荧惑。 十四年七月丁卯，九月己丑，俱犯岁星。 丙辰，掩岁星。 十二月癸丑，犯荧惑。 十七年十一月甲辰，犯岁星。 十八年二月丙寅，掩岁星。 九月乙巳，掩填星。
Hongzhi 4, second month, day renzi: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Hongzhi 7, eleventh month, day wushen: the moon encroached upon Mars. Hongzhi 8, first month, day guimao: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Hongzhi 8, twelfth month, day bingchen: the moon occulted Saturn. Hongzhi 11, fourth month day jiashen and ninth month day gengzi: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on both dates. Hongzhi 12, eighth month, day renyin: the moon encroached upon Mars. Hongzhi 14, seventh month day dingmao and ninth month day jichou: the moon encroached upon Jupiter on both dates. Hongzhi 14, day bingchen: the moon occulted Jupiter. Hongzhi 14, twelfth month, day guichou: the moon encroached upon Mars. Hongzhi 17, eleventh month, day jiachen: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Hongzhi 18, second month, day bingyin: the moon occulted Jupiter. Hongzhi 18, ninth month, day yisi: the moon occulted Saturn.
11
正德元年十一月己卯，犯太白。 四年闰九月癸亥，犯岁星。 八年正月己丑，犯填星。 十六年二月丙戌，掩太白。
Zhengde 1, eleventh month, day jimao: the moon encroached upon Venus. Zhengde 4, intercalary ninth month, day guihai: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Zhengde 8, first month, day jichou: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Zhengde 16, second month, day bingxu: the moon occulted Venus.
12
嘉靖二年五月戊子，掩岁星。 十一月壬申，犯岁星。 十七年十二月己未，犯填星。 十八年十月丙戌，犯荧惑。 二十年五月辛卯，犯岁星。 二十一年四月甲寅，二十七年七月丁丑，俱犯太白。 九月庚子，犯太白于角。 三十一年五月辛丑，犯填星。 九月庚寅，掩填星。 十二月丁卯，犯岁星。 四十二年五月庚辰，掩岁星。 四十四年七月丁巳，犯荧惑。
Jiajing 2, fifth month, day wuzi: the moon occulted Jupiter. Jiajing 2, eleventh month, day renshen: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Jiajing 17, twelfth month, day jiwei: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Jiajing 18, tenth month, day bingxu: the moon encroached upon Mars. Jiajing 20, fifth month, day xinmao: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Jiajing 21/IV/jiayin and 27/VII/dingchou: the moon encroached upon Venus on both dates. Jiajing 27, ninth month, day gengzi: the moon encroached upon Venus in the Horn lodge. Jiajing 31, fifth month, day xinchou: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Jiajing 31, ninth month, day gengyin: the moon occulted Saturn. Jiajing 31, twelfth month, day dingmao: the moon encroached upon Jupiter. Jiajing 42, fifth month, day gengchen: the moon occulted Jupiter. Jiajing 44, seventh month, day dingsi: the moon encroached upon Mars.
13
万历二年九月己卯，犯荧惑于箕。 十年八月戊申，犯荧惑于井。 十四年八月己丑，犯太白于角。 十五年六月乙丑，十九年九月辛未，俱犯荧惑。 十二月甲辰，犯填星于井。 二十四年正月甲申，犯填星于张。 二十七年九月辛亥，犯太白。 三十一年五月癸未，犯太白，三十五年六月乙未，犯填星于斗。 三十七年八月辛酉，犯填星。 四十一年九月癸未，犯岁星。
Wanli 2, ninth month, day jimao: the moon encroached upon Mars in the Winnowing Basket lodge. Wanli 10, eighth month, day wushen: the moon encroached upon Mars in the Well lodge. Wanli 14, eighth month, day jichou: the moon encroached upon Venus in the Horn lodge. Wanli 15/VI/yichou and 19/IX/xinwei: the moon encroached upon Mars on both dates. Wanli 19, twelfth month, day jiachen: the moon encroached upon Saturn in the Well lodge. Wanli 24, first month, day jiashen: the moon encroached upon Saturn in the Extended Net lodge. Wanli 27, ninth month, day xinhai: the moon encroached upon Venus. Wanli 31/V/guiwei: the moon encroached upon Venus; Wanli 35/VI/yiwei: the moon encroached upon Saturn in the Dipper lodge. Wanli 37, eighth month, day xinyou: the moon encroached upon Saturn. Wanli 41, ninth month, day guiwei: the moon encroached upon Jupiter.
14
崇祯三年八月辛亥，掩太白。 十一年四月己酉，掩荧惑于尾。
Chongzhen 3, eighth month, day xinhai: the moon occulted Venus. Chongzhen 11, fourth month, day jiyou: the moon occulted Mars in the Tail lodge.

▲ Occultations and encroachments among the five planets.
16
洪武六年三月戊申，荧惑犯填星。 六月壬辰，太白犯岁星。 八年三月癸亥，荧惑犯填星。 二十二年六月丙辰，辰星犯太白。 二十七年三月乙丑，荧惑犯岁星于奎。
Hongwu 6, third month, day wushen: Mars encroached upon Saturn. Hongwu 6, sixth month, day renchen: Venus encroached upon Jupiter. Hongwu 8, third month, day guihai: Mars encroached upon Saturn. Hongwu 22, sixth month, day bingchen: Mercury encroached upon Venus. Hongwu 27, third month, day yichou: Mars encroached upon Jupiter in the Stride lodge.
17
永乐三年三月戊戌，太白犯岁星。 十一月癸巳朔，太白犯辰星于箕。 四年正月癸卯，太白犯岁星。 五年七月甲子。 荧惑犯填星。 十二年十一月丁卯，太白犯岁星。 十四年七月乙巳，太白犯填星。 二十年九月乙亥，太白犯岁星。 十月己酉，太白犯填星。
Yongle 3, third month, day wuxu: Venus encroached upon Jupiter. Yongle 3, eleventh month, new moon on guisi: Venus encroached upon Mercury in the Winnowing Basket lodge. Yongle 4, first month, day guimao: Venus encroached upon Jupiter. Yongle 5, seventh month, day jiazi. Mars encroached upon Saturn. Yongle 12, eleventh month, day dingmao: Venus encroached upon Jupiter. Yongle 14, seventh month, day yisi: Venus encroached upon Saturn. In the twentieth year, on yihai of the ninth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the tenth month, on jiyou, Venus transgressed Saturn.
18
洪熙元年十一月丙午，太白犯填星。
In the first year of Hongxi, on bingwu of the eleventh month, Venus transgressed Saturn.
19
宣德元年十一月戊戌，辰星犯填星。 七年六月己酉，太白犯岁星。 七月辛巳，太白犯荧惑。 九年十一月己亥，太白犯填星。 十年十月庚子，荧惑犯填星。
In the first year of Xuande, on wuxu of the eleventh month, Mercury transgressed Saturn. In the seventh year, on jiyou of the sixth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the seventh month, on xinsi, Venus transgressed Mars. In the ninth year, on jihai of the eleventh month, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the tenth year, on gengzi of the tenth month, Mars transgressed Saturn.
20
正统元年五月戊寅，太白犯荧惑于井。 二年五月辛丑，荧惑犯填星。 三年十二月戊寅，太白犯岁星。 五年五月丙午，太白犯填星。 七年九月戊午，太白犯荧惑于氐。 十一年九月丁亥，太白犯岁星。 十二年七月戊午，荧惑犯填星。 十四年二月己卯，太白犯荧惑。 七月丙午，荧惑犯填星。
In the first year of Zhengtong, on wuyin of the fifth month, Venus transgressed Mars in Well. In the second year, on xinchou of the fifth month, Mars transgressed Saturn. In the third year, on wuyin of the twelfth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the fifth year, on bingwu of the fifth month, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the seventh year, on wuwu of the ninth month, Venus transgressed Mars in Root. In the eleventh year, on dinghai of the ninth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the twelfth year, on wuwu of the seventh month, Mars transgressed Saturn. In the fourteenth year, on jimao of the second month, Venus transgressed Mars. In the seventh month, on bingwu, Mars transgressed Saturn.
21
景泰元年闰正月丁卯，荧惑犯岁星。
In the first year of Jingtai, on dingmao of the intercalary first month, Mars transgressed Jupiter.
22
天顺七年十一月乙卯朔，荧惑犯填星。
In the seventh year of Tianshun, on yimao, the new moon of the eleventh month, Mars transgressed Saturn.
23
成化六年九月乙亥，太白犯岁星。 十一年七月戊辰，太白犯填星。 十三年九月丙寅，荧惑犯填星。 十六年六月壬申，太白犯岁星。
In the sixth year of Chenghua, on yihai of the ninth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the eleventh year, on wuchen of the seventh month, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the thirteenth year, on bingyin of the ninth month, Mars transgressed Saturn. In the sixteenth year, on renshen of the sixth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter.
24
弘治二年正月戊辰，太白犯岁星。 十一月壬午，太白犯填星。 三年正月庚申，太白犯填星。 五年八月丁未，荧惑犯岁星。 六年十一月己未，太白犯填星。 七年九月甲寅及十年正月丙辰，荧惑犯岁星。 十二月庚辰，辰星犯岁星。 十七年闰四月癸酉，岁星犯填星。
In the second year of Hongzhi, on wuchen of the first month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the eleventh month, on renwu, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the third year, on gengshen of the first month, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the fifth year, on dingwei of the eighth month, Mars transgressed Jupiter. In the sixth year, on jiwei of the eleventh month, Venus transgressed Saturn. On jiayin of the ninth month of the seventh year, and again on bingchen of the first month of the tenth year, Mars transgressed Jupiter. In the twelfth month, on gengchen, Mercury transgressed Jupiter. In the seventeenth year, on guiyou of the intercalary fourth month, Jupiter transgressed Saturn.
25
正德二年十月癸未，荧惑犯填星。 八年正月壬午及十六年十二月丙午，俱太白犯岁星。
In the second year of Zhengde, on guiwei of the tenth month, Mars transgressed Saturn. On renwu of the first month of the eighth year, and again on bingwu of the twelfth month of the sixteenth year, Venus transgressed Jupiter.
26
嘉靖元年正月己未，太白犯岁星。 十二月甲戌，太白犯填星。 三年正月癸酉，太白犯岁星。 二十九年六月庚辰，荧惑犯岁星守井。
In the first year of Jiajing, on jiwei of the first month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the third year, on guiyou of the first month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the twenty-ninth year, on gengchen of the sixth month, Mars transgressed Jupiter while holding Well.
27
万历五年十二月辛丑，太白犯填星于斗。 九年十二月癸巳，太白犯填星入危。 十一年六月丁丑，太白犯荧惑。 十五年五月己亥，太白犯填星。 二十四年四月己酉，太白犯岁星。 二十五年七月甲辰，荧惑犯岁星。 二十七年闰四月庚寅，辰星犯太白于井。 三十四年十一月庚辰，荧惑掩岁星于危； 甲辰，荧惑犯岁星。 三十八年十一月辛亥，太白犯填星于虚。 四十七年三月壬子，太白犯岁星于壁。
In the fifth year of Wanli, on xinchou of the twelfth month, Venus transgressed Saturn in Dipper. In the ninth year, on guisi of the twelfth month, Venus transgressed Saturn and entered Rooftop. In the eleventh year, on dingchou of the sixth month, Venus transgressed Mars. In the fifteenth year, on jihai of the fifth month, Venus transgressed Saturn. In the twenty-fourth year, on jiyou of the fourth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter. In the twenty-fifth year, on jiachen of the seventh month, Mars transgressed Jupiter. In the twenty-seventh year, on gengyin of the intercalary fourth month, Mercury transgressed Venus in Well. In the thirty-fourth year, on gengchen of the eleventh month, Mars occulted Jupiter in Rooftop; on jiachen, Mars transgressed Jupiter. In the thirty-eighth year, on xinhai of the eleventh month, Venus transgressed Saturn in Emptiness. In the forty-seventh year, on renzi of the third month, Venus transgressed Jupiter in Wall.
28
天启元年八月丙申，荧惑与太白同度者两日。
In the first year of Tianqi, on bingshen of the eighth month, Mars and Venus stood at the same longitude for two days.
29
崇祯九年六月己亥，太白犯岁星于张。
In the ninth year of Chongzhen, on jihai of the sixth month, Venus transgressed Jupiter in Extended Net.
30
▲五纬合聚
▲ Convergence of the Five Planets
31
洪武十四年六月癸未，辰星、荧惑、太白聚于井。 十七年六月丙戌，岁星、填星、太白聚于参。 十八年二月乙巳，五星并见。 三月戊子，填星、岁星、太白聚于井。 二十年二月壬午朔，五星俱见。 二十四年七月戊子，太白、荧惑、填星聚于翼。 十一月乙未，辰星、岁星合于斗。 十二月甲子，荧惑、辰星合于箕。 二十五年正月辛丑，荧惑、岁星合于牛。 二十六年十月壬辰，太白、填星同度。
In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, on guiwei of the sixth month, Mercury, Mars, and Venus gathered at Well. In the seventeenth year, on bingxu of the sixth month, Jupiter, Saturn, and Venus gathered at Shen. In the eighteenth year, on yisi of the second month, all five planets appeared at once. In the third month, on wuzi, Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus gathered at Well. In the twentieth year, on renwu, the new moon of the second month, all five planets were visible. In the twenty-fourth year, on wuzi of the seventh month, Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered at Wings. In the eleventh month, on yiwei, Mercury and Jupiter conjoined at Dipper. In the twelfth month, on jiazi, Mars and Mercury conjoined at Winnowing Basket. In the twenty-fifth year, on xinchou of the first month, Mars and Jupiter conjoined at Ox. In the twenty-sixth year, on renchen of the tenth month, Venus and Saturn stood at the same longitude.
32
永乐元年五月甲辰，五星俱见东方。 二年四月戊子，太白、荧惑合于井。
In the first year of Yongle, on jiachen of the fifth month, all five planets stood in the eastern sky. In the second year, on wuzi of the fourth month, Venus and Mars conjoined at Well.
33
正统十四年九月壬寅，太白、填星、荧惑聚于翼。 十二月辛未，太白、岁星合于尾。

按两星经纬同度曰掩，光相接曰犯，亦曰凌。 纬星出入黄道之内外，凡恒星之近黄道者，皆其必由之道，凌犯皆由于此。 而行迟则凌犯少，行速则多，数可预定，非如彗孛飞流之无常。 然则天象之示炯戒者，应在彼而不在此。 历代史志凌犯多系以事应，非附会即偶中尔。 兹取纬星之掩犯恒星者次列之。 比事以观，其有验者，十无一二，后之人可以观矣。 至于月道与纬星相似，而行甚速，其出入黄道也，二十七日而周，计其掩犯恒星殆无虚日，岂皆有休咎可占，今见于《实录》者不及百分之一，然已不可胜书，故不书。
Note: when two stars share the same longitude and latitude it is called yan (occultation); when their light meets it is fan (encroachment), also called ling. Planets move inside and outside the Yellow Path; fixed stars near the ecliptic all lie on paths they must cross—encroachments and transits all follow from this. Slow motion brings few transits; fast motion brings many; the counts can be foreknown—not like comets, broom-stars, and shooting stars, which are erratic. Heaven's bright warnings, then, should attach to those [irregular phenomena], not to these [planetary transits]. Dynastic astronomical treatises often link transits to events in the world—forced reading or lucky hits at best. Here we list in sequence planetary occultations and encroachments upon fixed stars. Set them beside historical events: fewer than one in ten match—later readers may judge for themselves. The moon's path resembles the planets', but it moves far faster; it crosses the Yellow Path and completes a circuit in twenty-seven days. Its occultations and encroachments upon fixed stars leave scarcely a day without one—yet could every such event foretell fortune or calamity? Those recorded in the Veritable Records are less than one percent, and even that is beyond writing; therefore they are omitted.
